01 / HOW IT ALL BEGAN

Every good story starts
with “remember when?”

Ours started at Brown Tree in 2019.
No grand entrance. No big plans.
Just two people who had no idea.

01
STRANGERS · 2019

Of all the people… you.

A mutual friend introduced us at Brown Tree. You were just a stranger then, Tom. I had no idea that one day, I’d call you my brother.

02
COLLEAGUES · THE FIRST TEXT

I texted first. Obviously.

We were colleagues, and I made the first move to say hello. But for the first two months? Quiet. Just a few words, with a whole story still waiting to happen.

03
FRIENDS · ONE RANDOM “HI”

Three letters changed everything.

A friend sent a random “Hi” from my phone. Who knew that tiny message would turn into real conversations, late-night talks and calls that never seemed long enough?

Hi the accidental beginning of everything ✓✓
04
BEST FRIENDS · ALL THE LITTLE THINGS

“Did you eat?” meant “I care.”

Your daily scoldings became my favourite proof that you cared. Our first outing was a movie with friends. Simple moments became our memories. And yes… I got possessive when you talked to others. You mattered more than I knew how to say.

05
BROTHER & SISTER · FAMILY, SOMEHOW

A bond without a big announcement.

Best friends slowly became brother and sister. Then came “Tom & Jerry.” No official day. No naming ceremony. It just fit. Between the teasing, the fights and the care, we found our own kind of family.

“We didn’t plan this story.
We simply lived it.”

05 / YOUR VERY LUCKY DAY

A little surprise for you…

Scratch to find out what you’ve won.

CONGRATULATIONS, TOM!

A Jerry for life!

06 / TIED WITH A LITTLE NONSENSE

Okay, one more gift.

This one has your name on it.

You were expecting a gift, right?

But the real gift is the bond we somehow found along the way. You came into my life unexpectedly… and became someone I never want to lose.

Thank you for being my Tom.

— Your Jerry.

P.S. The actual gift is coming… don’t get emotional yet.
YOU FOUND THE LAST LITTLE SECRET…

Tom, I don’t know when you stopped being a stranger. I don’t know when you became my best friend. And I don’t know exactly when you became my brother.

I just know that somewhere between all the laughs, fights, calls, care and countless little moments… you became family. And that’s something I’ll always be grateful for.

No matter how much life changes, I hope one thing never does… Tom & Jerry will always be Tom & Jerry.

Love you always. — Your Jerry.

07 / SOME BONDS JUST NEED A NAME

Happy Birthday, Tom.

You came into my life as a stranger, became my friend, my best friend, and somewhere along the way… you became my brother.

I may not always say it, but I hope you always know how much your presence means to me.

Thank you for every little thing, every laugh, every call, every fight, every bit of care, and simply for being you.

Some bonds don’t need an explanation.
Ours just needed a name…

TOM & JERRY✳

Happy Birthday to my Tom.

Forever your Jerry.
